lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The stars are leaning down to see
The secret place where we can be
A map unfolded on the floor
Behind a long-forgotten door
[chorus]
Oh, it's a magic story
Written in the dust and light
A technicolor glory
Burning through the velvet night
[verse]
The shadows dance upon the wall
We catch the echoes as they fall
Every page begins to bloom
Inside this quiet, golden room
[chorus]
Oh, it's a magic story
Written in the dust and light
A technicolor glory
Burning through the velvet night
[bridge]
Time stands still while we turn the leaf
Belief is short, but joy is brief
Hold on tight to what we've found
Before the morning comes around
[chorus]
Oh, it's a magic story
Written in the dust and light
A technicolor glory
Burning through the velvet night
[outro]
